scope: Read-only static shared-editor port review; four files plus directly related tests/host safety dependencies. Parent baseline406615bf8, SourceD current working bytes independently hashed; no blanket repo port.

decisions.decision: preserve-integrate only; do not replace whole file
decisions.evidence: Source removes figureAssetLocalFrame import/verified asset container extent branch and removes data-asset from keepsFrame, replacing group extents/ink with child recursion. Parent registered/legacy identity includes exact geometry signature, explicit transform grammar/finite/nonsingular checks and four-corner container. These are distinct contracts.
decisions.details: Generic group recursion composes child transforms correctly in extentPoints; inkPoints uses elementMatrix(child), including ancestry, so no obvious double-transform at that call. But recursive ink cannot certify identity, malformed-transform fallback, legacy frame whitespace or exact curve bounds. Source test uses fake data-asset=person arbitrary path/rect, which parent prepare would demote; passing it does not establish registered41/legacy39 compatibility. Removing keepsFrame(asset) alone currently still reaches frame fallback because bake has no g case; not evidence of current group body rewriting. Preserve explicit asset keepsFrame nevertheless.
decisions.safePlan: Keep current figureAssetLocalFrame early return for verified assets before optional generic-g recursion. Protect inkPoints too: a new generic-g early recursion there must not bypass the verified asset container branch. Keep strict identity/legacy registries unchanged. Define ink-vs-container behavior for align/spread separately; do not silently shift registered asset alignment centers.

decisions.evidence: expandFigureFrame changes viewBox via widenFigureFrame and scales explicit numeric width/height proportionally; no child geometry mutation in these functions. Thus it is not literally viewBox-only, but user-coordinate geometry is preserved.
decisions.limits: At fixed CSS viewport displayed size may change; distinguish geometry units from screen zoom. Existing widenFigureFrame validates w>0 but not h>0, parses width/height with parseFloat and rewrites numeric values (percent/unit suffixes can lose semantics), and rounds to3decimals. New wrapper checks finite view but not positive width/height or runtime axis enum. These are preexisting helper limits exposed through a new command, not proof of normal numeric fixture distortion. Add supported positive view/size-unit and invalid-axis checks before broad acceptance.

decisions.decision: optional prop addition compatible; UI integration parent-owned
decisions.evidence: onExpand optional; existing onFit retained. margin UI rejects nonfinite/outside1..1000, while helper permits up to10000 and positive fractions. This is an explicit UI-vs-helper domain difference, not necessarily defect.
decisions.limits: No rendered React/focus/undo/UI inspection; new command must use single commit and preserve rejected/unchanged SVG history.

decisions.decision: conditional integration with explicit transport policy; cut lifecycle HOLD
decisions.evidence: Only new module memory slot functions added; existing prepare-on-paste, ID/local-reference remapping, new numbering and geometry wrappers unchanged. Token is opaque UUID, not SVG encryption or origin security. Source handler read-only inspection confirms external image/svg+xml/text/plain fallback remains.
decisions.limits: Single memory slot cannot support cross-tab/reload/OS history; after copyB tokenA is stale. Cut removes source after setting event data but does not establish later resolvability/durable custom MIME support. Synchronous throw avoids deletion but memory slot already changed. State this as a lifecycle/data-availability risk, not an observed browser loss. Require explicit unsupported/stale token notice and a safe cut policy or retained recovery buffer/rollback. Never silently claim opaque transport preserves all external interoperability.

Current arrow guards/root-ID/style inheritance repairs; moving marker definitions and reprepare must not broaden unsafe metadata acceptance.

testEvidence: Read SourceD assetTransforms/align/frame/fit tests. They are not own executions. The selected frame tests cover widenFrame numeric scaling, not new expand command invalid dimensions/units; selected asset test is synthetic, not registered/legacy host contract. No runtime clipboard lifecycle/DOM/browser claims.
